oracle.method: m-separation in every MAG of the class, by hand enumeration of the member MAGs
oracle.generator: hand-derived; statuses are statements about every member (separated / connected) or undetermined. An edge is '<a><left mark>-<right mark><b>' with marks '<' / '>' arrowhead, 'o' circle, 'x' conflict, none for a tail: '0->1', '0<->1', '0o-o1', '0o->1', '0-o1', '0x-x1'.
oracle.reference: Zhang (2008), On the completeness of orientation rules for causal discovery, definite-status paths

cases.reason: 0 and 2 are not adjacent and 1 is not marked a collider, so 1 is a non-collider in all three members (0->1->2, 0<-1<-2, 0<-1->2)
0 is a definite collider between 1 and 2; 0 -o 3 is 0 -> 3 in every member, so conditioning on 3 opens it although 3 is not a definite descendant
0 o-o 1 o-o 2 o-o 3 is not of definite status; every member MAG (a DAG without a collider at 1 or 2 on the unshielded triples 0-1-3 and 0-2-3) separates 0 and 3 given {1, 2}
0 o-o 2 o-o 3 is an unshielded definite non-collider path avoiding the conditioning set
a conflict mark records that the orientation at 1 is unknown; the path is neither discarded nor asserted
